answer: Fixed-pool dilution blocks bulk fakes: one pool splits equally. Each identity opens a cedar tally, locks 70 credits. It files a cipher-sealed receipt: work hash, key, epoch. Auditors replay claims before the pulse, burning bonds for duplicates, mismatch, rented tallies. Fees rise per tally: first 45, kth 45+7(k-1). 1,000 fakes cost 3,541,500 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 haul: a loss over 3,500,000. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond.
